Mateo's ticket for Door 14 at Newark is #8841. I replied to you in the DM with the details.

Second-shift drivers at Newark couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk in the Pemberline Dock carrier portal. It also says you escalated it to platform engineering.
